# Zoom control (`zoom-control`)

− / preset / + zoom with fit.

Group: Media & editors. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/media';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createZoomControl` (types in `dist/web/media/zoomControl.d.ts`): `.mh-zoom-control` (`--sm`): zoom out, a native `<select>` of preset levels (the current level is added when itisn't a preset), zoom in, and a Fit toggle (`aria-pressed` while fitted). Parts: `__step`, `__level` with`__select` and `__chevron`, `__fit`. − and + carry `aria-disabled` at the limits.

```ts
export function createZoomControl(options: ZoomControlOptions): ZoomControlHandle;

export interface ZoomControlOptions {
  /** Current zoom; 1 is 100 %. */
  value: number;
  min?: number;
  max?: number;
  /** Levels offered in the menu and stepped through by − and +. */
  presets?: readonly number[];
  /** Shows the Fit button (default true). */
  showFit?: boolean;
  /** The view is fitted to its frame: the Fit button shows as pressed. */
  fitted?: boolean;
  size?: ZoomControlSize;
  disabled?: boolean;
  labels?: Partial<ZoomControlLabels>;
  /** A new level from −, + or the menu. */
  onChange?: (value: number) => void;
  onFit?: () => void;
}

export interface ZoomControlHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  setValue(value: number): void;
  setFitted(fitted: boolean): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}

export interface ZoomControlLabels {
  group: string;
  zoomOut: string;
  zoomIn: string;
  level: string;
  fit: string;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createZoomControl } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const zoom = createZoomControl({
  value: 1,
  min: 0.25,
  max: 8,
  onChange: () => zoom.setFitted(false),
  onFit: () => {
    // The level that fits the picture in its frame, worked out by the app.
    zoom.setValue(0.63);
    zoom.setFitted(true);
  },
});

document.body.append(zoom.el);
```

## React API

`ZoomControl` (types in `dist/react/media-editors.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createZoomControl`. Controlled: pass the new `value` back from `onChange`.

```ts
export function ZoomControl({ value, min = 0.1, max = 8, presets = ZOOM_PRESETS, showFit = true, fitted = false, size = 'medium', disabled = false, labels, onChange, onFit, className }: ZoomControlProps);

export interface ZoomControlProps {
  value: number;
  min?: number;
  max?: number;
  presets?: readonly number[];
  showFit?: boolean;
  fitted?: boolean;
  size?: ZoomControlSize;
  disabled?: boolean;
  labels?: Partial<ZoomControlLabels>;
  onChange?: (value: number) => void;
  onFit?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { ZoomControl } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

// The level that fits the picture in its frame, worked out by the app.
const FIT_LEVEL = 0.63;

export function ZoomControlExample() {
  const [zoom, setZoom] = useState(1);
  const [fitted, setFitted] = useState(false);
  const change = (value: number) => {
    setZoom(value);
    setFitted(false);
  };
  const fit = () => {
    setZoom(FIT_LEVEL);
    setFitted(true);
  };
  return <ZoomControl value={zoom} min={0.25} max={8} fitted={fitted} onChange={change} onFit={fit} />;
}
```
